issues.claim: shoulder-length dark brown hair pushed back from his face
issues.actual: Jesus' hair reads as loosely flowing/wavy rather than clearly pushed back -- a minor styling nit, still shoulder-length and dark brown, no halo or glow present

issues.claim: Nathanael... caught off-balance, his head pulled back in astonishment
issues.actual: Nathanael's pose reads more as a purposeful mid-stride approach than clearly off-balance, though his expression is astonished/open-mouthed
